The '''[[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]''' of the [[Ryn/Legends|Ryn]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was generally believed to be located somewhere in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TNJOS" /> The Ryn had no idea which [[Planet/Legends|world]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] was their original home, as they had moved from it long before their history was recorded.<ref name="TNEGtAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> Not even the massive [[Library/Legends|libraries]] of [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]] and [[Woostri/Legends|Woostri]] could confirm what their homeworld might have been.<ref name="TNJOS" />
